$comment: No dataGroups on purpose: the app stores /api/** responses in IndexedDB itself (resource.service.ts) and reads them from there in offline mode. Caching them again in ngsw would keep the same few megabytes twice. With SSR (outputMode: server) the CSR shell is named index.csr.html – the name index.html is reserved for prerendered pages. It is the offline navigation fallback, so it must be in assetGroups.
